title: Portland's Eclectic Tour: Thrift, Coffee, Bakes, & Books
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off at select downtown Portland hotels
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: All guests will be required to sign an acknowledgement of the Safety Briefing that will be given at the start of the tour.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Are you ready to transform an ordinary afternoon into an unforgettable adventure? Whether you're a lover of fashion, a foodie, or a coffee and wine enthusiast, this tour will be a delightful afternoon filled with shopping, snacking, and sipping. So, grab your favorite tote bag, and let's dive into a world of fun and flavor!
